import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import os
import logging

# Setup basic logging to see all operations
logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s"
)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def main():
    # Load data
    logger.info("Loading datasets...")
    try:
        train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv", low_memory=False)
        test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv", low_memory=False)
        sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv", low_memory=False)
        logger.info(f"Loaded train: {len(train)} rows, test: {len(test)} rows")
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to load data: {e}")

    # Ensure submission directory exists
    os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
    logger.info(f"Created submission directory: ./submission/")

    # Columns
    feature_col = "comment_text"
    target_cols = [
        "toxic",
        "severe_toxic",
        "obscene",
        "threat",
        "insult",
        "identity_hate",
    ]

    # Feature extraction - TF-IDF with reasonable parameters for large dataset
    logger.info("Feature extracting with TF-IDF...")
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        max_features=10000,
        min_df=5,  # Increase to reduce noise
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=False,  # Preserve case sensitivity which might be important
        stop_words=None,  # Don't remove stop words for this task
    )

    X_train_sparse = vectorizer.fit_transform(train[feature_col])
    logger.info(
        f"Feature matrix shape: {X_train_sparse.shape}, density: {X_train_sparse.nnz / X_train_sparse.shape[0] / X_train_sparse.shape[1]:.4f}"
    )

    # Keep sparse matrix for LGBM compatibility and memory efficiency
    # Convert to array if needed for splitting strategy
    X_train_array = X_train_sparse

    # Target labels
    logger.info(f"Preparing targets for {len(target_cols)} classes...")
    y_train = train[target_cols].values.astype(int)
    n_targets = len(target_cols)
    logger.info(f"Target shape: {y_train.shape}")

    # Split training into train and validation for holdout evaluation
    # IMPORTANT: stratify=y_train ensures balanced class representation
    logger.info("Splitting training data...")
    try:
        X_train_split, X_holdout, y_train_split, y_holdout = train_test_split(
            X_train_array,
            y_train,
            test_size=0.1,  # Smaller holdout set for faster validation
            random_state=42,
            stratify=y_train,
            shuffle=True,
        )
        logger.info(f"Train: {len(X_train_split)}, Holdout: {len(X_holdout)}")
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to split data: {e}")

    # Initialize LightGBM model with tuned hyperparameters for this scale
    model = LGBMClassifier(
        num_leaves=63,
        learning_rate=0.03,
        n_estimators=800,
        subsample=0.9,
        colsample_bytree=0.9,
        verbose=-1,  # Disable progress bar
        force_col_wise=True,
        random_state=42,
        max_depth=8,
        feature_fraction=0.9,
        bagging_freq=2,
        min_child_samples=20,
        reg_alpha=0.1,
        reg_lambda=0.1,
        min_data_in_leaf=10,
    )

    # Train on training data only (NOT holding out for refitting)
    logger.info("Training model...")
    try:
        model.fit(X_train_split, y_train_split)
        logger.info("Model training completed")
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to train model: {e}")

    # Validate on holdout BEFORE final predictions
    logger.info("Evaluating on holdout set...")
    val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_holdout)

    # Compute column-wise ROC AUC on holdout
    auc_scores = []
    for i in range(n_targets):
        y_holdout_i = y_holdout[:, i].astype(float)
        val_preds_i = val_preds[:, i]

        try:
            score = roc_auc_score(y_holdout_i, val_preds_i)
            auc_scores.append(score)
            logger.info(f"AUC for target {i} ({target_cols[i]}): {score:.4f}")
        except ValueError as ve:
            # Edge case: if binary classification threshold issue
            logger.warning(f"Warning computing AUC for target {target_cols[i]}: {ve}")
            auc_scores.append(np.nan)

    val_auc = np.nanmean(auc_scores) if len(auc_scores) > 0 else np.nan
    logger.info(f"Validation Column-Wise ROC AUC: {val_auc:.4f}")

    # Predict on full test set
    logger.info("Predicting on test set...")
    try:
        X_test = vectorizer.transform(test[feature_col])
        test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test)
        logger.info(f"Test predictions shape: {test_preds.shape}")
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to transform test data: {e}")

    # Format submission matching sample_submission format
    # Use template to ensure correct column ordering
    logger.info("Creating submission file...")
    try:
        # Build submission DataFrame directly
        output_columns = ["id"] + target_cols

        submission = pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "id": test["id"].values,
            }
        )

        for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
            submission[col] = test_preds[:, i]

        # Save to exact required path
        submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"
        submission.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
        logger.info(f"Saved {len(submission)} predictions to {submission_path}")

        # Verify file was saved correctly
        submitted_df = pd.read_csv(submission_path)
        logger.info(f"Verified submission shape: {submitted_df.shape}")
        logger.info(f"Columns: {list(submitted_df.columns)}")

    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to save submission: {e}")

    # Final confirmation
    logger.info("=" * 50)
    logger.info("COMPLETION SUMMARY:")
    logger.info(f"- Validation AUC: {val_auc:.4f}")
    logger.info("- Submission file saved successfully")
    logger.info(f"- Test predictions: {len(test_preds)} samples x {n_targets} targets")
    logger.info("=" * 50)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
